title: The Buffalo Institute for Contemporary Art

description.markdown: The Buffalo Institute for Contemporary Art (BICA) is a new arts and education project for Buffalo, NY. Our mission is to break down barriers between contemporary art world and the everyday, making lives better through practical engagements with contemporary art.

title: Short experimental film by peter campus, Three Transitions 1973

description.markdown: Three Transitions (1973), a video project in which he manipulates his own image in three different, self-effacing sequences. "The tape is one of the seminal works in video. In three short exercises, Campus uses basic techniques of video technology and his own image to create succinct, almost philosophical metaphors for the psychology of the self.

title: All you need to know about caching for serverless applications | theburningmonk.com

description.markdown: Last week, someone asked me at the AWS User Group in The Hague "Is caching still relevant for serverless applications?" The assumption there is that Lambda auto-scales by traffic, so do we still need to worry about caching? And if so, where and how do we implement caching?
